lec02nn-frame-u01.name: lec02nn-frame-u01
lec02nn-frame-u01.text: 獨立假設把指數壓回線性

lec02nn-u01-1-title.name: lec02nn-u01-1-title
lec02nn-u01-1-title.text: 聯合機率的估計量爆炸

lec02nn-u01-1-counts.name: counts
lec02nn-u01-1-counts.text: 二元特徵的估計量：聯合機率2^l−1與獨立假設2l的對數尺度曲線

image.alt: 二元特徵的估計量：聯合機率2^l−1與獨立假設2l的對數尺度曲線

lec02nn-u01-1-why.name: lec02nn-u01-1-why
lec02nn-u01-1-why.text:
每個特徵有兩值，共有 $2^l$ 種組合。
獨立假設把指數變線性。

Binary features give 2^l combinations.
Independence changes exponential growth to linear.

lec02nn-u01-1-scope.name: lec02nn-u01-1-scope
lec02nn-u01-1-scope.text:
本講義涵蓋 2.5–2.6 節。
圖中數字為模擬或示範值。

Sections 2.5–2.6. Figures are simulated or illustrative, not textbook originals.

lec02nn-u01-2-countbar.name: countbar
lec02nn-u01-2-countbar.text: l=10時聯合估計需要1023個值，獨立假設需要20個值

image.alt: l=10時聯合估計需要1023個值，獨立假設需要20個值

lec02nn-u01-3-title.name: lec02nn-u01-3-title
lec02nn-u01-3-title.text: 資料需求也隨維度爆炸

lec02nn-u01-3-growth.name: growth
lec02nn-u01-3-growth.text: 同一估計量曲線顯示維度提高後聯合估計與獨立估計的數量級差距

image.alt: 同一估計量曲線顯示維度提高後聯合估計與獨立估計的數量級差距

lec02nn-u01-3-data.name: lec02nn-u01-3-data
lec02nn-u01-3-data.text:
可靠估計聯合密度約需 $N^l$ 樣本。
十維獨立估計約需 $20N$。

Reliable joint estimation needs order N^l samples; independence needs about 20N at l=10.

lec02nn-u01-3-motto.name: lec02nn-u01-3-motto
lec02nn-u01-3-motto.text:
維度一高，不做假設就算不出來。

In high dimensions, skipping the assumption becomes impossible.

lec02nn-frame-u02.name: lec02nn-frame-u02
lec02nn-frame-u02.text: 已知類別後才假設獨立

lec02nn-u02-1-title.name: lec02nn-u02-1-title
lec02nn-u02-1-title.text: 聯合密度拆成一維乘積

lec02nn-u02-1-expl.name: lec02nn-u02-1-expl
lec02nn-u02-1-expl.text:
知道類別後，特徵一不再透露特徵二的訊息。
Given the class, feature 1 gives no extra information about feature 2.

lec02nn-u02-2-score-c2-t.name: lec02nn-u02-2-score-c2-t
lec02nn-u02-2-score-c2-t.text:
對數連加
Sum log scores

lec02nn-u02-2-log.name: lec02nn-u02-2-log
lec02nn-u02-2-log.text:
對數單調，最大者不變；避免小數連乘下溢。

Log is monotone: the winner is unchanged.
Summing logarithms avoids product underflow.

lec02nn-u02-3-title.name: lec02nn-u02-3-title
lec02nn-u02-3-title.text: 高度相關會讓機率失真

lec02nn-u02-3-wrong-t.name: lec02nn-u02-3-wrong-t
lec02nn-u02-3-wrong-t.text:
✗ 獨立只是簡化，準確度不受影響。

Independence only simplifies algebra; accuracy is unaffected.

lec02nn-u02-3-right-t.name: lec02nn-u02-3-right-t
lec02nn-u02-3-right-t.text:
✓ 高度相關會扭曲機率，甚至改變決策。

Strong correlation distorts probability estimates and may change the decision.

lec02nn-u02-3-motto.name: lec02nn-u02-3-motto
lec02nn-u02-3-motto.text:
用一個可能錯的假設，換取少好幾個數量級的資料量。
Trade one possibly wrong assumption for orders of magnitude less data.

lec02nn-u02-3-symbols.name: lec02nn-u02-3-symbols
lec02nn-u02-3-symbols.text: $\mathbf{x}$: feature vector · $x_j$: feature j · $l$: dimension · $\omega_i$: class i

lec02nn-frame-u03.name: lec02nn-frame-u03
lec02nn-frame-u03.text: 二元特徵給出線性判別

lec02nn-u03-1-title.name: lec02nn-u03-1-title
lec02nn-u03-1-title.text: 二元特徵的對數比是線性

lec02nn-u03-1-binary-t.name: lec02nn-u03-1-binary-t
lec02nn-u03-1-binary-t.text:
① $p_i$ 與 $q_i$ 是兩類出現機率。

p_i and q_i are probabilities of feature i being 1 in the two classes.

lec02nn-u03-1-ratio-t.name: lec02nn-u03-1-ratio-t
lec02nn-u03-1-ratio-t.text:
② 乘積相除取對數，逐項配對。

Divide products, take logarithms, and pair the per-feature terms.

lec02nn-u03-1-linear-t.name: lec02nn-u03-1-linear-t
lec02nn-u03-1-linear-t.text:
③ 每個特徵乘權重後加總。

Each feature gets a weight; the weighted sum is linear.

lec02nn-u03-1-linear-plot.name: linear-plot
lec02nn-u03-1-linear-plot.text: 使用講義前兩字詞權重的g對x1線性函數，固定x2=0

image.alt: 使用講義前兩字詞權重的g對x1線性函數，固定x2=0

lec02nn-u03-2-setup.name: lec02nn-u03-2-setup
lec02nn-u03-2-setup.text:
先驗：spam 0.4，ham 0.6。
此數值示範為講義補充。

P(spam)=0.4; P(ham)=0.6.
Added numerical example, not the original source example.

lec02nn-u03-3-title.name: lec02nn-u03-3-title
lec02nn-u03-3-title.text: 未出現的字詞也要計入

lec02nn-u03-3-factors-c2-t.name: lec02nn-u03-3-factors-c2-t
lec02nn-u03-3-factors-c2-t.text:
各因子相乘
Multiply all factors

lec02nn-u03-3-absent.name: lec02nn-u03-3-absent
lec02nn-u03-3-absent.text:
第三字詞未出現，ham 因子是 $1-0.4=0.6$。

Word 3 is absent; its ham factor is 1−0.4=0.6.

lec02nn-u03-4-title.name: lec02nn-u03-4-title
lec02nn-u03-4-title.text: 先驗加權後仍判垃圾郵件

lec02nn-u03-4-post.name: post
lec02nn-u03-4-post.text: 垃圾郵件與非垃圾郵件的未正規化事後機率0.0288與0.00036

image.alt: 垃圾郵件與非垃圾郵件的未正規化事後機率0.0288與0.00036

lec02nn-u03-4-winner.name: lec02nn-u03-4-winner
lec02nn-u03-4-winner.text:
分母只使總和為一，不改變誰較大。
這封郵件判為 spam。

Normalisation preserves the winner.
Classify this e-mail as spam.

lec02nn-u03-5-title.name: lec02nn-u03-5-title
lec02nn-u03-5-title.text: 權重加總也給相同答案

lec02nn-u03-5-wplot.name: wplot
lec02nn-u03-5-wplot.text: 四個字詞的權重依講義公式解析計算，第三字詞權重最小

image.alt: 四個字詞的權重依講義公式解析計算，第三字詞權重最小

lec02nn-u03-6-title.name: lec02nn-u03-6-title
lec02nn-u03-6-title.text: 判別分數可還原事後機率

lec02nn-u03-6-score-t.name: lec02nn-u03-6-score-t
lec02nn-u03-6-score-t.text:
① 郵件分數為 $g=4.382027$。

The e-mail log-odds score is 4.382027.

lec02nn-u03-6-sigmoid-t.name: lec02nn-u03-6-sigmoid-t
lec02nn-u03-6-sigmoid-t.text:
② sigmoid 回到 spam 機率 0.987654。

The sigmoid maps the score back to P(spam)=0.987654.

lec02nn-u03-6-origins-t.name: lec02nn-u03-6-origins-t
lec02nn-u03-6-origins-t.text:
③ 二元獨立與等共變異數都導出線性。

Binary independence and shared Gaussian covariance lead to the same linear form.

lec02nn-u03-6-sigmoid-plot.name: sigmoid-plot
lec02nn-u03-6-sigmoid-plot.text: sigmoid函數在g=4.382027處給出事後機率0.987654

image.alt: sigmoid函數在g=4.382027處給出事後機率0.987654

lec02nn-u03-7-title.name: lec02nn-u03-7-title
lec02nn-u03-7-title.text: 兩字詞的邊界是一條直線

lec02nn-u03-7-cross.name: lec02nn-u03-7-cross
lec02nn-u03-7-cross.text:
截距：1.000000、−0.065278、−1.130557。
更多特徵時，邊界仍是超平面。
More features: the boundary remains a hyperplane.

lec02nn-frame-u04.name: lec02nn-frame-u04
lec02nn-frame-u04.text: 最近鄰居直接用票數決策

lec02nn-u04-1-title.name: lec02nn-u04-1-title
lec02nn-u04-1-title.text: 先選鄰居再看類別投票

lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c0-t.name: lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c0-t
lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c0-t.text:
比全部 $N$ 點距離
Compare all N vectors

lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c1-t.name: lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c1-t
lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c1-t.text:
保留最近 $k$ 點
Keep k nearest

lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c2-t.name: lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c2-t
lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c2-t.text:
數各類 $k_i$ 票
Count votes

lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c3-t.name: lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c3-t
lec02nn-u04-1-knn-c3-t.text:
分給最多票類別
Choose largest count

lec02nn-u04-1-labels.name: lec02nn-u04-1-labels
lec02nn-u04-1-labels.text:
挑鄰居時不看類別標籤；分類時才做全部工作。

Neighbour selection ignores labels.
There is no training stage; all work occurs at classification time.

lec02nn-u04-1-symbols.name: lec02nn-u04-1-symbols
lec02nn-u04-1-symbols.text: $N$: samples · $k$: voting neighbours · $k_i$: class i count · $M$: classes

lec02nn-u04-2-title.name: lec02nn-u04-2-title
lec02nn-u04-2-title.text: 十一鄰居以七比四判紅色

lec02nn-u04-2-vote.name: vote
lec02nn-u04-2-vote.text: 23個示範樣本中，r11圓內恰有7紅4黑；星形是查詢點，圓外12點不投票

image.alt: 23個示範樣本中，r11圓內恰有7紅4黑；星形是查詢點，圓外12點不投票

lec02nn-u04-2-counts.name: lec02nn-u04-2-counts
lec02nn-u04-2-counts.text:
半徑 $r_{11}$ 到第十一位鄰居。
圓外灰點不投票。

The dashed circle reaches the 11th neighbour.
Grey points outside do not vote.

lec02nn-u04-2-decision.name: lec02nn-u04-2-decision
lec02nn-u04-2-decision.text:
多數決判為紅色。
示範圖 $n=23$，seed=11。

Majority vote decides red.
Illustrative positions; n=23, seed=11.

lec02nn-u04-3-title.name: lec02nn-u04-3-title
lec02nn-u04-3-title.text: 最近鄰居有漸進誤差保證

lec02nn-u04-3-bound.name: bound
lec02nn-u04-3-bound.text: NN漸進誤差界以M=2作為公式的解析切片，顯示PB與2PB之間的上界

image.alt: NN漸進誤差界以M=2作為公式的解析切片，顯示PB與2PB之間的上界

lec02nn-u04-3-kone.name: lec02nn-u04-3-kone
lec02nn-u04-3-kone.text:
$k=1$：只看最近一個樣本的類別。
當 $N\to\infty$，誤差最多為最優解兩倍。

For k=1, use the closest sample’s class.
As N→∞, NN error is at most twice Bayes error.

lec02nn-u04-3-motto.name: lec02nn-u04-3-motto
lec02nn-u04-3-motto.text:
最笨的規則，最多只比最聰明的差一倍。
The dumbest rule is at most twice as wrong.

lec02nn-u04-4-title.name: lec02nn-u04-4-title
lec02nn-u04-4-title.text: 百分之一點零三尚未核實

lec02nn-u04-4-source-t.name: lec02nn-u04-4-source-t
lec02nn-u04-4-source-t.text:
✗ 來源稱：Bayes 1% 時，3NN 約 1.03%。

The source claims 3-NN error ≈1.03% when Bayes error is 1%.

lec02nn-u04-4-calc-t.name: lec02nn-u04-4-calc-t
lec02nn-u04-4-calc-t.text:
✓ 上界代入 $P_B=0.01$、$k=3$ 得 0.360181。

The stated bound gives 0.360181 (about 36%), not 1.03%.

lec02nn-u04-4-warning.name: lec02nn-u04-4-warning
lec02nn-u04-4-warning.text:
兩數不符；請老師確認。正文不採用未核實數字。

The source value is inconsistent and needs teacher confirmation.
Do not treat 1.03% as a verified result.

lec02nn-u04-5-title.name: lec02nn-u04-5-title
lec02nn-u04-5-title.text: 選鄰居數時要留意平手

lec02nn-u04-5-q-t.name: lec02nn-u04-5-q-t
lec02nn-u04-5-q-t.text:
為何 $k$ 通常取奇數，且避開 $M$ 的倍數？

Why is k usually odd and not a multiple of the number of classes M?

lec02nn-u04-5-hint-t.name: lec02nn-u04-5-hint-t
lec02nn-u04-5-hint-t.text:
講義原則：避免票數相同。
分類規則取 $k_i$ 最大者。

Lecture guideline: reduce tied votes.
The rule selects the largest class count.

lec02nn-u04-5-tie-caution.name: lec02nn-u04-5-tie-caution
lec02nn-u04-5-tie-caution.text:
票數規則：多數決。
Majority vote chooses the class with the largest count.

lec02nn-frame-u05.name: lec02nn-frame-u05
lec02nn-frame-u05.text: 最近鄰居把平面切成地盤

lec02nn-u05-1-title.name: lec02nn-u05-1-title
lec02nn-u05-1-title.text: 每個樣本都有一塊地盤

lec02nn-u05-1-voronoi.name: voronoi
lec02nn-u05-1-voronoi.text: 18個樣本的解析Voronoi多邊形，兩個查詢星形指向最近地主；seed=7

image.alt: 18個樣本的解析Voronoi多邊形，兩個查詢星形指向最近地主；seed=7

lec02nn-u05-1-land.name: lec02nn-u05-1-land
lec02nn-u05-1-land.text:
把比其他樣本更接近自己的點收集起來。
所有地盤拼滿空間。

Each sample owns points closer to itself than to any other sample.
The cells tile the whole space.

lec02nn-u05-1-caption.name: lec02nn-u05-1-caption
lec02nn-u05-1-caption.text:
邊界兩側等距；查詢星形跟最近地主。
Euclidean illustration: n=18, seed=7.

lec02nn-u05-2-title.name: lec02nn-u05-2-title
lec02nn-u05-2-title.text: 地盤合併成類別決策區域

lec02nn-u05-2-cells.name: cells
lec02nn-u05-2-cells.text: Voronoi保留每個訓練樣本一格的完整地盤邊界

image.alt: Voronoi保留每個訓練樣本一格的完整地盤邊界

lec02nn-u05-2-regions.name: regions
lec02nn-u05-2-regions.text: 相鄰同類地盤合併後僅保留不同類別的決策邊界

image.alt: 相鄰同類地盤合併後僅保留不同類別的決策邊界

lec02nn-u05-2-cell-label.name: lec02nn-u05-2-cell-label
lec02nn-u05-2-cell-label.text:
樣本地盤：每個樣本一格。
Tessellation: one cell per sample.

lec02nn-u05-2-region-label.name: lec02nn-u05-2-region-label
lec02nn-u05-2-region-label.text:
分類：看所站地盤的地主類別。
Decision: use the tile owner’s class.
Same-class neighbours merge, also for M>2.

lec02nn-frame-u06.name: lec02nn-frame-u06
lec02nn-frame-u06.text: 鄰居數拉扯偏誤與變異

lec02nn-u06-1-title.name: lec02nn-u06-1-title
lec02nn-u06-1-title.text: 小鄰域追雜訊大鄰域抹平

lec02nn-u06-1-small.name: small
lec02nn-u06-1-small.text: 講義seed=3的300個半月訓練樣本與12個標錯點，k=1決策邊界追隨雜訊

image.alt: 講義seed=3的300個半月訓練樣本與12個標錯點，k=1決策邊界追隨雜訊

lec02nn-u06-1-large.name: large
lec02nn-u06-1-large.text: 同一300點資料的k=41決策邊界抹平局部交錯結構

image.alt: 同一300點資料的k=41決策邊界抹平局部交錯結構

lec02nn-u06-1-variance.name: lec02nn-u06-1-variance
lec02nn-u06-1-variance.text:
小 k：尖刺邊界，變異大。
Small k follows even mislabelled samples: high variance.

lec02nn-u06-1-bias.name: lec02nn-u06-1-bias
lec02nn-u06-1-bias.text:
大 k：跨過交錯處，偏誤大。
Large k erases structure: high bias.
n=300; 12 flipped labels; seed=3.

lec02nn-u06-2-title.name: lec02nn-u06-2-title
lec02nn-u06-2-title.text: 測試誤差在七鄰居最低

lec02nn-u06-2-minimum.name: lec02nn-u06-2-minimum
lec02nn-u06-2-minimum.text:
誤差先降後升；$k=7$ 最低 0.50%。
$k=1$：4.50%；$k=41$：3.50%。

Error falls then rises. The minimum is 0.50% at k=7.
k=1: 4.50%; k=41: 3.50%.

lec02nn-u06-2-experiment.name: lec02nn-u06-2-experiment
lec02nn-u06-2-experiment.text:
測試集 400 點，固定亂數種子。

400 test samples; fixed seed.
The plotted values are exactly the lecture table.

lec02nn-u06-3-wrong-t.name: lec02nn-u06-3-wrong-t
lec02nn-u06-3-wrong-t.text:
✗ 更多鄰居資訊，分類一定更穩。

More neighbours must always produce a better classification.

lec02nn-u06-3-right-t.name: lec02nn-u06-3-right-t
lec02nn-u06-3-right-t.text:
✓ 太遠的樣本抹掉局部真實結構。

An over-large neighbourhood includes irrelevant far-away samples and erases local structure.

lec02nn-u06-3-sweetspot.name: lec02nn-u06-3-sweetspot
lec02nn-u06-3-sweetspot.text:
誤差先降後升；最低點才是最佳解。

The bottom of the U is the optimum, not a mediocre compromise.

lec02nn-frame-u07.name: lec02nn-frame-u07
lec02nn-frame-u07.text: 彈性與資料需求一起增加

lec02nn-u07-1-title.name: lec02nn-u07-1-title
lec02nn-u07-1-title.text: 越少形狀假設越需資料

lec02nn-u07-1-method0.name: lec02nn-u07-1-method0
lec02nn-u07-1-method0.text:
密度為高斯；直線或二次曲線。
代價：形狀假設可能不符。

Gaussian density; linear or quadratic boundary.
Cost: shape mismatch.

lec02nn-u07-1-method1.name: lec02nn-u07-1-method1
lec02nn-u07-1-method1.text:
特徵獨立；二元特徵為線性。
代價：忽略相關性。

Independent features; binary-feature linearity.
Cost: ignored correlations.

lec02nn-u07-1-method2.name: lec02nn-u07-1-method2
lec02nn-u07-1-method2.text:
幾乎無形狀假設；高度非線性。
代價：每次分類 $O(kN)$。

Almost no shape assumption; nonlinear boundary.
Cost: O(kN) per query.

lec02nn-u07-1-direction.name: lec02nn-u07-1-direction
lec02nn-u07-1-direction.text:
往右更靈活，但更需資料。
Moving right buys flexibility at the cost of more data.

lec02nn-u07-2-title.name: lec02nn-u07-2-title
lec02nn-u07-2-title.text: 沒有訓練不代表分類便宜

lec02nn-u07-2-cost-t.name: lec02nn-u07-2-cost-t
lec02nn-u07-2-cost-t.text:
✗ 沒有訓練階段，所以每次分類便宜。

No training stage does not mean cheap classification.

lec02nn-u07-2-query-t.name: lec02nn-u07-2-query-t
lec02nn-u07-2-query-t.text:
✓ 每次與全部 $N$ 點比距離，原文記為 $O(kN)$。

Every query compares with all N samples; the lecture states O(kN).
Efficient search and prototype editing/condensing reduce the burden.

lec02nn-u07-2-caution.name: lec02nn-u07-2-caution
lec02nn-u07-2-caution.text:
漸進保證須 $N$ 夠大；樣本少時可能不如貝氏。

Asymptotic guarantees require sufficiently large N.
With little data, k-NN can underperform Bayes classifiers.

lec02nn-u07-3-title.name: lec02nn-u07-3-title
lec02nn-u07-3-title.text: 一邊換假設一邊直接投票

lec02nn-u07-3-motto-t.name: lec02nn-u07-3-motto-t
lec02nn-u07-3-motto-t.text:
單純貝氏：獨立假設，把指數壓回線性。
最近鄰居：不估密度，直接讓鄰居投票。

Naive Bayes uses independence to make estimation linear.
Nearest neighbours estimate no density and vote directly.

lec02nn-u07-3-summary.name: lec02nn-u07-3-summary
lec02nn-u07-3-summary.text:
記住：對數比、線性邊界、漸進誤差界、地盤與 k 的拉扯。
Remember log scores, binary-feature linearity, asymptotic bounds, Voronoi cells, and the k trade-off.

lec02nn-u07-3-objective.name: lec02nn-u07-3-objective
lec02nn-u07-3-objective.text:
學習目標：能解釋估計量、寫規則、推導權重、算郵件、說明地盤與選 k。
Objectives: counts, rules, weights, e-mail computation, Voronoi geometry, and choosing k.

lec02nn-u07-4-title.name: lec02nn-u07-4-title
lec02nn-u07-4-title.text: 改特徵與鄰居後重新思考

lec02nn-u07-4-q1-t.name: lec02nn-u07-4-q1-t
lec02nn-u07-4-q1-t.text:
郵件第三字詞改成 $x_3=1$，重算未正規化事後機率並決策。

Set word 3 to present. Recompute both unnormalised posteriors and decide.

lec02nn-u07-4-q2-t.name: lec02nn-u07-4-q2-t
lec02nn-u07-4-q2-t.text:
第十二近是黑點，改用 $k=9$，投票會改變嗎？

The 12th nearest point is black. With k=9, does the vote change?

lec02nn-u07-4-hints.name: lec02nn-u07-4-hints
lec02nn-u07-4-hints.text:
提示：0 與 1 的因子不同；先數較小圓內兩類票數。
Hints: presence and absence use different factors; count the smaller circle first.
No answers: discuss in class or on the discussion board.

lec02nn-u07-5-title.name: lec02nn-u07-5-title
lec02nn-u07-5-title.text: 平手與相關性都值得警覺

lec02nn-u07-5-q3-t.name: lec02nn-u07-5-q3-t
lec02nn-u07-5-q3-t.text:
為何 k 常取奇數，且不要是類別數的倍數？
提示：想想平手。

Why is k usually odd and not a multiple of M?
Hint: think about tied votes.

lec02nn-u07-5-q4-t.name: lec02nn-u07-5-q4-t
lec02nn-u07-5-q4-t.text:
解釋「犧牲精確度換取資料量」，並舉高度相關時會出錯的情境。

Explain the accuracy-for-data trade-off and give a strongly correlated-feature failure scenario.

lec02nn-u07-5-noanswers.name: lec02nn-u07-5-noanswers
lec02nn-u07-5-noanswers.text:
只給問題與提示；答案在課堂或討論區討論。
Problems and hints only; discuss answers in class or on the discussion board.

lec02nn-u07-6-title.name: lec02nn-u07-6-title
lec02nn-u07-6-title.text: 機率術語連回郵件計算

lec02nn-u07-6-terms0.name: lec02nn-u07-6-terms0
lec02nn-u07-6-terms0.text:
單純貝氏分類器 — naive Bayes classifier

統計獨立 — statistically independent

聯合機率密度 — joint probability density

類別條件密度 — class-conditional density

lec02nn-u07-6-terms1.name: lec02nn-u07-6-terms1
lec02nn-u07-6-terms1.text:
先驗機率 — prior probability

事後機率 — posterior probability

未正規化事後機率 — unnormalised posterior

證據 — evidence

lec02nn-u07-6-terms2.name: lec02nn-u07-6-terms2
lec02nn-u07-6-terms2.text:
概似函數 — likelihood

線性判別函數 — linear discriminant function

下溢 — underflow

lec02nn-u07-7-title.name: lec02nn-u07-7-title
lec02nn-u07-7-title.text: 近鄰術語連回空間與誤差

lec02nn-u07-7-terms.name: lec02nn-u07-7-terms
lec02nn-u07-7-terms.text:
最近鄰居法則 — nearest-neighbour rule

k近鄰分類器 — k-nearest-neighbour classifier

多數決投票 — majority vote

Voronoi鑲嵌 — Voronoi tessellation

決策區域 — decision region

lec02nn-u07-7-variance-t.name: lec02nn-u07-7-variance-t
lec02nn-u07-7-variance-t.text:
變異 — variance
偏誤 — bias

Small k / large k trade-off

lec02nn-u07-7-prototype-t.name: lec02nn-u07-7-prototype-t
lec02nn-u07-7-prototype-t.text:
原型精簡
prototype editing/condensing
Reduce the training set used at query time.

lec02nn-u07-7-bayeserror-t.name: lec02nn-u07-7-bayeserror-t
lec02nn-u07-7-bayeserror-t.text:
貝氏最優誤判機率

Bayes-optimal error probability

lec02nn-u07-8-title.name: lec02nn-u07-8-title
lec02nn-u07-8-title.text: 延伸閱讀回到本週教材

lec02nn-u07-8-book-t.text:
教科書第2章 2.5–2.6節。

Theodoridis & Koutroumbas
Pattern Recognition, 4th ed.
Chapter 2, Sections 2.5–2.6.

lec02nn-u07-8-web-t.text:

lec02nn-u07-8-week-t.name: lec02nn-u07-8-week-t
lec02nn-u07-8-week-t.text:
本週另見貝氏決策理論與無母數密度估計。

See lec02.md and the nonparametric density estimation note.
